answer: Latency-Ridge Identity Ceremony.** Each identity must solve a per-epoch cipher challenge whose solution depends on serial computation over uniquely issued seed material, then broadcast a whisper beacon at a scheduled slot along a shared timing ridge; nodes reject any identity whose slot collides or whose beacon arrives outside its narrow window. Enforcement: the ridge admits one slot per seed, so clones must either duplicate seeds (caught by beacon collisions) or acquire fresh ones through the ceremony.
